title: Foundation Model Transparency Index
content: Stanford CRFM evaluates foundation-model developers across 100 transparency indicators and reports multi-year changes in model, data, capability, risk, and governance disclosure.

title: Reliable and Efficient Amortized Model-Based Evaluation
content: CRFM integrated IRT-based adaptive testing into HELM to reduce the number of test instances while preserving evaluation reliability.

title: Agentic AI systems: from scruffy to neat
content: A June 2026 MIT CSAIL talk compares reactive prompting, chain-of-thought and tool use with more formal symbolic and probabilistic approaches to LLM-powered agents.

title: Teaching AI agents to ask better questions by playing Battleship
content: MIT CSAIL reports an uncertainty-aware agent approach that outperformed a frontier model while operating at around one percent of its cost in the studied setting.

title: Latest research
content: Ai2's 2026 research stream includes benchmark auditing, tutor-agent evaluation, deterministic tool and guardrail design for reliable agents, hybrid-model token analysis, multimodal motion forecasting, and an evaluation workbench for model development.

title: Open models - Language models
content: Ai2 publishes open model families including Olmo 3, Olmo 2, Tulu 3 and OLMoE together with data, code, recipes, checkpoints and evaluation assets.

title: How researchers adapted Dolma for better Thai language models
content: Ai2 describes use of Dolma to create a 47-billion-token Thai pretraining corpus, illustrating localization of open data-curation pipelines.

title: 从AI Coding到世界模型：大模型如何重构世界丨2026智源大会回顾
content: 2026智源大会讨论 AI Coding、自主智能体、模型自进化、世界模型与具身智能，并强调清晰数据闭环对能力提升的重要性。

title: CompassArena 大语言模型榜单
content: OpenCompass uses cleaned anonymous pairwise user votes and a Bradley-Terry model to estimate arena ratings, and publishes confidence intervals and vote counts.

title: CNFinBench 评测榜单
content: CNFinBench publishes quantitative rankings for large-language-model and agent performance in financial scenarios, including model scores by track.
